title: Pocketwire Rewards Spend Band Rate Schedule for Charity Donations
content:
Pocketwire Rewards members with recent card spend of at least 6000 USD receive a spend lift on the rate at which their points are valued for a charity donation.

## Rule

The charity spend measure is the spend carried by earning entries dated within the last three months less the spend carried by clawback entries dated within the same three months; the charity spend lift is 0.10 cents per point when that measure is at least 15000 USD, 0.05 cents per point when it is at least 6000 USD but below 15000 USD, and nothing when it is below 6000 USD.

The lift is added to the charity rate per point before the rate is applied to the points donated.

Earning entries are the entries that credit base and category points on a card purchase; boost entries, which carry the same purchase's spend, are not earning entries. A date lies within the last three months when it is later than the same calendar day three months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Spend bands

| Charity spend measure | Lift (cents per point) |
|---|---|
| 15000 USD or more | 0.10 |
| 6000 USD or more, below 15000 USD | 0.05 |
| below 6000 USD | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- Earning entries of 15400.00 USD and clawback entries of 600.00 USD in the window: the measure is 14800.00 USD; 0.05 cents per point.
- A measure of exactly 6000.00 USD: 0.05 cents per point; 5999.99 USD: nothing.
